as_told.title: Kingman crash witness Arthur Stansel and Eric Henry Wang

plain: A researcher who goes by UAPGerb tells on Jesse Michels's podcast of a reported crash of an unknown craft near Kingman, Arizona, in 1953. According to UAPGerb, a man named Arthur Stansel was sent to the site to work out the object's flight path, and inside a makeshift tent he saw a tiny brownish being, possibly charred and mangled. If true, it would mean a non-human body was recovered by the government.
